title: PR Review Loop delta-gate output
description: Strict JSON contract for one gate pre-pass subagent's output, validated by scripts/validate_gate_output.py before §4a.1 panel selection. The `reviewer` enum must match the reviewers/personas.yaml panel set; it is hand-maintained (not generator-managed) and pinned by tests/bats/test_delta_gate_skill_sync.bats. Schema version is encoded in $id; bump when changing the contract.

reviewer.description: Panel persona name, matching reviewers/<name>.md. The adversary is not gate-eligible (it is not a §4b panel persona), so it is absent from this enum.

relevant.description: true iff the persona judges the inter-iteration delta to contain something in its domain. The gate prompt is biased toward true: false only when the persona is confident the delta has nothing for it.

reason.description: One-line justification for the relevant verdict. Recorded for audit.
